notes: ISA International Sign Expo 2025 took place April 23-25, 2025 at the Mandalay Bay Convention Center in Las Vegas, Nevada (not Orlando as shown on current website which displays 2026 information). The event attracted approximately 20,000 attendees and nearly 600 exhibitors. The official exhibitor list was not publicly accessible through the event website or mobile app without registration credentials. Companies listed include confirmed exhibitors with booth numbers where available, and likely exhibitors based on past participation, industry partnerships, and post-show reports. All companies listed are relevant to DuPont Tedlar's ICP as manufacturers, distributors, or suppliers of sign materials, protective films, vehicle graphics, wide-format printing equipment, or related products and services. Key product categories represented include: protective films/overlaminates, vehicle wrap materials, wide-format printers, sign substrates, fabrication equipment, and coating systems.
